theorems.name: Submission.allard52_am_fc_radial_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (R ε : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (ball y R)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y R → 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (1 + ε) * t < R → ∫ x, ((n : ℝ) * φ (‖x - y‖ / t) + ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * (1 - w x)) ∂μ = (n : ℝ) * ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ + ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ - ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ ∧ 0 ≤ ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ ∧ ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ ≤ 0
